mentions.name: Wireshark
mentions.description: An effort to improve the accessibility (#a11y) of Wireshark, the network protocol capture/analysis tool, whose current accessibility is poor; includes a first submitted PR and relearning the Qt/C++ codebase so blind and low-vision IT professionals can use the tool.
mentions.problem: Wireshark's current accessibility is poor, affecting the many blind and low vision IT folks for whom the tool is a job requirement.
mentions.audience: Blind and low vision IT folks for whom this tool is a job requirement
mentions.source_excerpt: For now I have mostly moved on from gaming and am instead working on improving the accessibility (#a11y) of the Wireshark network protocol capture/analysis tool. There are a lot of blind and low vision IT folks for whom this tool is a job requirement.
